title: MA-Bench: Measuring Operational Planning in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19138v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How well can a language model turn a large, incomplete and partly contradictory body of documents into a plan when no single correct answer exists? We introduce Mission Analysis (MA)-Bench, built on mission analysis, the first step of military operational planning, in which a staff reads the full situation and states the problem before anyone proposes a solution. Its 10 expert-built scenarios pair synthetic packets of ten to twelve documents with 1,257 expert-written pass/fail requirements, each containing information on their source, question type, and importance level. A reasoning-model judge grades each brief against the requirements without seeing the documents; it grades like a fifth credentialed planner, leaving a four-planner panel's agreement unchanged (Fleiss $\kappa$ 0.42 to 0.41), and a judge from a second provider reproduces the model ranking (Spearman 0.94). Across twenty frontier and open-weights models the best gets 62%

translated_title: MA-Bench：测量语言模型的作战规划能力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.19138v1 公告类型：交叉（cross） 摘要：当不存在唯一正确答案时，语言模型能在多大程度上将庞大、不完整且部分矛盾的文档集合转化为一份计划？我们提出了任务分析基准（MA-Bench），该基准建立在军事作战规划的第一个步骤——任务分析之上。在这一步骤中，参谋人员需要通读全部态势信息，并在任何人提出解决方案之前先陈述问题。该基准包含10个由专家构建的场景，每个场景将10至12份文档组成的合成资料包与1,257条由专家编写的通过/失败要求相配对，每条要求均包含其来源、问题类型和重要性级别的信息。一个推理模型评判器在不查看文档的情况下，依据这些要求对每份简报进行评分；其评分表现如同第五位持证规划人员，且不改变由四位规划人员组成的评审小组的评分一致性（Fleiss κ 从0.42变为0.41），而来自另一家提供商的评判器也能重现相同的模型排名（Spearman 0.94）。在二十个前沿模型和开源权重模型中，表现最好的模型得到62%……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出了基于军事作战规划第一步“任务分析”构建的MA-Bench基准，用于评估语言模型在缺少唯一正确答案的情况下，从不完整且矛盾的文档集合中形成态势分析报告的能力。
en_tdlr: MA-Bench is a benchmark built on the mission analysis step of military operational planning to evaluate language models' ability to produce situation briefs from large, incomplete, and contradictory document sets when no single correct answer exists.
